description: Finds the GameDig ID a gamedig (game server) monitor needs in its game field, by game name or ID, e.g. "minecraft", "counter strike 2", "valheim". Returns each match's ID, name, default port and notes. Uptime Kuma does not check the ID when the monitor is saved, so look it up rather than guess.

limit.description: How many to return (default: 20, up to 100)

search.description: Part of the game name or ID; matched loosely. Omit to list games from the start.

name: listGames

count.description: How many games matched, of which `games` holds the first `limit`

title: List Games
